''See also: [[Copper Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Copper represents the foundational stage of the [[sacred arts]], serving as the initial step for practitioners. At this level, an individual's [[spirit]] opens, allowing them to perceive and harvest the [[vital aura]] present in the natural world. By [[cycling]] this energy from the heavens and earth, a Copper can process it into [[madra]], providing them with a more expansive and effective power supply to fuel their bodies. This ability to see [[aura]] is often described as a significant sensory shift, as those at this stage can perceive the world through colored visual representations of different elemental energies. While reaching this stage is a common milestone for many by age thirteen, it remains a vital prerequisite for further [[advancement]]. In terms of combat and physical capability, [[Coppers]] possess a distinct advantage over those who are unsouled, though they remain significantly less powerful than those at the [[Iron stage]], who possess superhuman physical attributes.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Copper represents a specific stage of progression and [[advancement]] within the realm. At this level, an individual can perceive [[aura]] and possesses heightened senses. While it serves as a rank or status held by [[Tash]], the term also functions as a type of currency or value in the region. For [[Lindon]], reaching this stage meant one of his cores attained the rank, though it was eventually transmuted from Copper to [[Iron]].}}
